Dear [user_name], There is no advanced manual available for analog scaling or encoder integration. Encoders relate to counters or high-speed counters. For high-speed counters (up to 5kHz with DC versions), use a counter or threshold trigger right after the input. If a function block is added in between, the maximum counting frequency is limited by the scan time of [product_name]. For analog signal scaling, refer to the online trainings and review the sample projects on the [company_name] website ([url]), under 'Application examples for [product_name]'. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion emphasizes that newcomers frequently look for guidance with [product_name], and there is a strong interest in free training resources. Online examples and step-by-step training resources significantly support beginners, though those wishing to explore advanced scenarios may need to experiment independently due to limited official documentation.
